messages:
tara_partners: FYI APAC cohort had two issues today: vouchers blocked by local tax rules and mentors unclear on handoff protocol. Need a tiny playbook ASAP.

ashley_ops: Oof. Which markets? If it's Vietnam/ID we need reseller fallback. If SG/HK it's usually paperwork.

ken_si: It was Indonesia and Philippines. Vendor required local tax ID for shipment; partner couldn't accept delivery. Mentor started lab anyway and had to pause.

mia_marketplace: I'll add a 'reseller vs marketplace' column to the SKU mapping and flag offers that need tax IDs. Can also include a sample vendor email template.

si-bot: Task created: #P-8122 "APAC SKU & Mentor Playbook" assigned to mia_marketplace, due 2024-08-02.

tara_partners: We also need a short mentor badge gate: require 2 shadow sessions + one proctored practical where mentor runs validation script and walks through voucher flow. Keeps it simple.

ken_si: Agreed. Suggest mentor can only trigger voucher redemptions after passing badge. Prevents mid-cohort chaos.

ashley_ops: I'll draft a 1-page decision tree: Step A pre-flight checks (taxID, customs flag, vendor contact), Step B if reseller required (invoicing flow), Step C mentor go/no-go checklist. ETA Wednesday.

mia_marketplace: I'll attach the CSV and a 'tax_covered' flag. Also include a 2-line copy mentors can paste to confirm voucher claims.

tara_partners: Quick copy suggestion for Slack: 

"Hi @partner, please confirm voucher CLAIM-XYZ was redeemed and whether tax/duties apply. If duties apply, state amount or vendor contact"

ken_si: Also add a tiny pre-flight script we can ask partners to run before labs. Example: nvidia-smi, uname -r, curl to assets.

si-bot: Meeting scheduled: APAC SI rapid sync \u2014 2024-08-05 03:00 UTC. Invite sent.

tara_partners: Thanks team. We'll keep updates in this thread and post the doc links once ready.
